show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/EQF5nK
show.description: A wealthy but secretive businessman, Rohit returns to India to reunite with his longtime fiancée, only to be humiliated and rejected because of his “low status.” At the same time, ambitious CEO Shanaya Mittal crosses paths with him during a business crisis, leading to a chaotic fake-marriage proposal, corporate rivalry, and betrayal.
